full_details: In the morning the leaf was as you had left it. The Prince was in the square, with no speech. Under that, cords, and a ladder of rope, and nothing under them. You added nothing. At dinner she heard the stair. You said the back was eased, and you did not make a feast of it. The tooth was the same tooth. The loaf was the loaf you had left, a penny and a full thumb short, and you ate three bites. You told her the Knave, at two, and no name of a side. You went as billed. No order had come. At the Theatre the plot gave the title and the hour, and no name of a part. Across the water the Rose had its own bill. You did not cross.
one_sentence: The back was eased on the stair, and at two you played the Knave.
title: The stair, and the Knave
